description: NaTiCPO₇ crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁ space group. Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.21-2.61 Å. Ti is bonded to six O atoms to form TiO₆ octahedra that share corners with four equivalent PO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Ti-O bond distances ranging from 1.91-2.04 Å. C is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three O atoms. There is one shorter (1.23 Å) and two longer (1.34 Å) C-O bond lengths. P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four equivalent TiO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 32-35°. There are a spread of P-O bond distances ranging from 1.53-1.56 Å. There are seven inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a bent 120 degrees geometry to one Na and one C atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a distorted T-shaped geometry to one Na, one Ti, and one C atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to one Na, one Ti, and one C atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to one Ti and one P atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Ti, and one P atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Ti, and one P atom. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to one Ti and one P atom.
